description: The plot illustrates how evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL.) varies with the activated parameters ratio for three model configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio(%)” on a linear scale, spanning from 100 down to 25, with tick labels at 100, 75, 50, and 25 (decreasing left to right). The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL.” on a linear scale, ranging approximately from 11.4 to 14.4 with regularly spaced tick marks every 0.5 (11.5, 12.0, 12.5, 13.0, 13.5, 14.0). A gray solid line with square markers (“Only MoHD FFN”) stays near 11.45 at 100 and 75, dips slightly to about 11.35 at 50, then rises to about 11.8 at 25. A dark navy solid line with circular markers (“Only MoHD ATTN”) starts around 11.45 at 100, increases slightly to about 11.55 at 75, rises to about 12.25 at 50, and then increases sharply to about 14.3 at 25. A bright blue solid line with x-shaped markers (“MoHD ATTN + MLP”) begins around 11.45 at 100, is about 11.5 at 75, increases to about 12.05 at 50, and rises further to about 13.2 at 25. A red dashed horizontal reference line is drawn across the plot at roughly 11.6 on the y-axis.
